verdict.rationale: Typesense's API docs walk through the full loop: create a collection, add documents, then search and filter. The official Typesense Cloud MCP server lets an agent "build collections, index your data, tune search" from the conversation, with a documented `claude mcp add` command, and the complete API surface ships in the open-source server. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent running the end-to-end flow, MCP server documented only for Typesense Cloud (not self-hosted), no discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes 404).
